overclaims: CoreWeave reported $2.575 billion of Q2 2026 revenue, raised more than $10 billion of new debt, and on Oct 27, 2026 scheduled its Q3 call.
The weak reading, that the IPO alone would not be enough, is arguably borne out by later borrowing.
checks.note: The supplied evidence does not contain the $2.575 billion revenue figure. Later borrowing does not establish that IPO proceeds were insufficient for survival; the packet explicitly leaves survival versus growth financing unresolved. The excerpt, criteria, citations, and unresolved open-horizon outcome otherwise match the frozen case.
